notes: PrivacyProtect is a SvelteKit 1 app with every route prerendered (+layout.server.ts sets prerender = true). Encryption runs entirely in the browser with WebCrypto, and there is no backend, database, or account. Setup: mise.toml pins node 22.11.0 (from .tool-versions/engines), then `npm ci` and `.ui-capture/build.sh`. That script runs `LOCAL_HTTP_BUILD=1 npm run build` (adapter-vercel) and copies .vercel/output/static to .ui-capture/out. It then adds dir/index.html copies of each *.html page for clean URLs (/blog, /security, /privacy-and-terms, /blog/introducing-privacyprotect), installs the analytics stub, and runs seed-secrets.mjs. Two build-only changes in svelte.config.js: kit.paths.relative=false (absolute /_app URLs so pages also load as dir/index.html), and the CSP `upgrade-insecure-requests` directive turned off when LOCAL_HTTP_BUILD=1 (it would rewrite local http asset loads to https). Data: the app stores nothing per user (no accounts, no localStorage), so an established user sees the same encrypt form as a new user. Its only output is self-contained encrypted 'secret' HTML files. seed-secrets.mjs uses the repo's own CLI (./cli.ts encrypt) to generate 14 realistic ones in out/secrets/*.html: 10 messages (guest WiFi, Netflix family login, landlord ACH, mom's Medicare portal, AWS break-glass root, SSH deploy passphrase, safe deposit box, garage/alarm codes, client SFTP, Ledger seed phrase with no hint) and 4 files (W-2 CSV, GitHub recovery codes .txt, home-network .env, lease deposit receipt .txt). Passwords and hints are in .ui-capture/secrets.json, e.g. /secrets/wifi-guest-network.html with password 'harbor'. verify-secrets.ts decrypts them all with src/lib/decrypt.ts. The repo's own examples are /example-message.html and /example-image.html (password 'dog'). Main areas: / (home: intro, Instructions disclosure, form with Message/File radio, message textarea or file drop zone, password with show/hide toggle, password hint, 'Conceal and download secret' button), /blog (post list), /blog/introducing-privacyprotect (long post with code blocks and an image), /security, /privacy-and-terms, and the 'Reveal secret' pages (/example-*.html, /secrets/*.html: password-hint card, password field, Reveal secret button). Known limitation: generated secret files link their favicon to https://www.privacyprotect.dev/favicon.svg (hardcoded in src/assets/template.html), so the icon doesn't load offline.
